items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Also, we had a tenor player, another saxophone player named Lester Taylor.

ctx.x: But getting back to Albuquerque, I met a guy... Also, we had a tenor player, another saxophone player named Lester Taylor. He said he could get me a gig with Gene Coy's band, so...
